news.text: Victor Wembanyama and the Spurs pounced on the Warriors with an 18-0 opening run and went on to win 123-85.

news.title: Warriors' Yaxel Lendeborg (1-for-13) 'flustered' in blowout loss to Spurs
news.text: In his first game as the primary offensive engine in place of the injured Stephen Curry, Warriors rookie Yaxel Lendeborg went 1-of-13 shooting in a 123-85 blowout loss to the Spurs. "I was flustered the entire game," he said. "Couldn't make a damn layup."

news.title: Castle scores season-high 32 points as Spurs stop the Warriors 123-85 for 11th straight win
news.text: — Stephon Castle scored a season-high 32 points, Victor Wembanyama had 12 points and 12 rebounds and the San Antonio Spurs won their 11th straight game, rolling past the Golden State Warriors 123-85 Friday night to remain unbeaten in NBA Cup play.
